name: LumiRAG
tagline: Multi-tenant RAG knowledge platform shared by several client products
highlights: Runs two RAG engines — LightRAG (graph RAG) and RAGFlow (document RAG) — with a dual/auto router that picks the engine per query.
Query modes naive / local / global / hybrid / mix, streaming answers, optional reranking and per-workspace LLMs (Gemini, OpenAI, OpenRouter).
Unstructured ingestion pipeline for PDF and Office files: OCR/VLM layout extraction, chunking and embedding, run as retryable, monitored jobs.
Multi-tenant RBAC with JWT, tiered API keys, per-request audit logs, a public OpenAPI gateway, webhooks and usage/billing metrics; observability with Langfuse.

name: BHYT AI Assistant
tagline: RAG Q&A over Vietnamese health-insurance regulations for medical staff
highlights: Every answer cites its source, and the assistant refuses to answer when the evidence is weak.
Async AI service with LangChain + LangGraph for intent detection and appendix search, falling back to OpenAI when the RAG API is unavailable.
LLM-based ETL over legal decrees and decisions: uploaded PDF/DOCX files get AI metadata extraction and automatic chunking.
Human-in-the-loop feedback loop with dataset export for fine-tuning.

name: HSU AI Admissions CRM
tagline: Omnichannel AI chatbot and CRM for student recruitment at Hoa Sen University
highlights: “Smart Query” agent pipeline — intent analyzer → query builder → retriever → response generator — turns natural-language questions into database queries.
Answers only from retrieved context, enforced by an anti-hallucination system prompt, with session memory.
Call transcription with speaker separation (Google Speech-to-Text v2), OCR and lead scoring.
Scheduled jobs for AI recaps, proactive alerts, conversation-quality checks and lead sync.

name: Business Filing Review AI
tagline: AI review of business-registration filings for an industrial-zone authority
highlights: Claude reads PDFs and images for OCR, classification and field extraction; staff make the final decision.
Per-document check sheets, a cross-document comparison matrix, rule-based legal checks, retrieval of past decisions and citation verification.
One LLM wrapper for streaming, Zod-validated structured output, retries, token/cost accounting and per-business quotas.
Every AI run is an immutable, reproducible record; the audit log is append-only, enforced by a database trigger.

name: Lumi API Portal
tagline: Multi-tenant AI APIs for banks and enterprises
highlights: Text-to-SQL agent pipeline for merchant chatbots — intent classifier → query validator → value normalizer → SQL executor — streamed over SSE.
OCR extraction of product lists and ID cards, plus conversational flows for shop registration, orders and customers.
Vector RAG service on Qdrant and a travel-itinerary chat with web search and citations.

name: Linh
tagline: Agentic AI personal assistant on web, mobile and desktop
highlights: Tool-calling agent loop with per-profile allow-lists, capped iterations, OAuth pause/resume and sanitized tool errors.
Skills and long-term memory, with memory decay based on spaced repetition.
Multi-document ingestion (PDF with page-level vision, DOCX, PPTX, XLSX) that checks completeness and asks clarifying questions.

name: Stock Knowledge Graph
tagline: LLM ETL pipeline that turns an investment library into an interactive mind map
highlights: 5-step batch pipeline: extract → LLM summary to a fixed 14-field JSON schema → synonym normalization → knowledge-graph build → mind map.
Idempotent re-runs with cost logged per call across 123 units.
Cost cut with the Claude Batch API, prompt caching and a “lean output” mode.

name: Legal AI Data & API
tagline: Legal-assistant API gateway and legal-document crawling for a legal-information provider
highlights: Partner API gateway with streaming chat over LightRAG with references, conversation CRUD and document upload, secured by API keys and an IP whitelist.
Legal crawler with an anti-bot browser and a structural parser for chapters, sections, articles, clauses and points, plus cross-references and metadata.

name: Video Intelligence
tagline: AI highlight extraction for national broadcasters and streaming platforms
highlights: Async pipeline: scene detection → Whisper ASR → per-clip vision descriptions → LLM ranking of highlights.
Smart 9:16 cropping that tracks people and faces (YOLOv8, MediaPipe), plus subtitles, logos and watermarks.
Esports and sports highlights from audio spikes, kill-feed OCR and GPT-4o selection of climax moments.
In-video product detection and an auto QC → human QC → marketplace publishing workflow.

name: Lumi Camera
tagline: AIoT real-time vision and Vietnamese voice agent for the smart home
highlights: Webcam video over WebSocket with YOLO detection; a vision LLM analyzes the scene only when it changes.
Real-time voice agent with tool calling and barge-in — slow image analysis runs in the background without blocking the conversation.
Spatial memory for questions like “where are my keys?”.

name: Zeedata, AI Studio & Customer Care
tagline: Other AI products shipped at Lumination
highlights: Zeedata — SaaS for document-grounded chatbots with a RAGFlow backend, a public v1 API and an embeddable web-component widget.
AI Studio LMS — turns PDF/DOCX/PPTX into courses with slides, TTS narration and video, with human review before publishing.
Omnichannel Customer Care — AI reply suggestions, summaries, sentiment analysis, next-best-action and call transcription.

name: Lumi A.I Meet
tagline: AI meeting assistant: recording, transcripts, summaries and reports in Vietnamese
highlights: Records meetings and turns them into transcripts.
Summarises each meeting and exports a report automatically.
Built for Vietnamese-language meetings.

name: Creative Adapt
tagline: One master design, re-composed for Facebook, Google, Zalo, TikTok and 40+ ad formats
highlights: Analyses a master design and re-composes it for every ad size.
Turns static designs into motion graphics.
Sharp output, ready for review and publishing.

name: Lumistu
tagline: AI creative platform for characters, objects, scenes and film
highlights: Generates images, video and AI characters from a single description.
Keeps characters and objects consistent across scenes.
Ready-made templates for ads, viral clips, cinema, fashion and animation.

name: ElasticV
tagline: Vietnamese AI voice platform with voice cloning
highlights: Vietnamese text-to-speech built on the Zeevoice engine.
Voice cloning tuned specifically for Vietnamese.
Voice library, advanced controls and an API for developers.

name: EduPay
tagline: Digital school operations and tuition payments connecting schools and families
highlights: Automatic payment reconciliation with dynamic QR codes.
Automatic e-invoices (S-Invoice).
Fee management for schools, plus apps for teachers and parents.

name: GoTrust
tagline: Trusted digital platforms for education, healthcare, finance and public services
highlights: Programmes including Digital Citizen Stations, MediPay, EduPay and AI.Care.
Core capabilities: e-identity and authentication, data integration and secure digital payments.
Security, monitoring and scalable infrastructure underneath every solution.

name: Hotel Group AI Concierge
tagline: 24/7 agentic RAG chatbot and livechat platform for a hotel chain
highlights: Embeddable widget where guests ask questions, book rooms and order services.
Agentic RAG engine on LangGraph with a Postgres checkpointer, intent router, booking-intent detection, strict tool-calling runner and tool-event audit table.
Knowledge-base ingestion (PDF, DOCX, TXT, MD, website crawl) → chunker → Qdrant, with a separate multilingual embedder service.
SiteMinder/PMS integration and an admin panel with per-hotel RBAC, livechat takeover and an agent evaluation suite.

name: AI-native ERP
tagline: AI-native ERP and social intranet for a large enterprise
highlights: Sales/CRM, purchasing, warehouse, finance, HR with Vietnamese payroll and tax, tasks with a 12-rule engine, customer care and more — 80 designed screens.
AI Copilot for free-form Vietnamese questions about company data that refuses off-topic questions and never invents numbers.
Telegram agent with role-scoped read-only tools, 6-turn memory and confirmation before any write.
Face-recognition attendance with server-side GPS geofencing; integrated chat, video, mail and drive.

name: Apartment Management Platform
tagline: Apartment-building management platform with an AI agent
highlights: Portal for residents and management: fees, maintenance fund, feedback, reports and financial transparency.
AI assistant on Hermes Agent calling the backend through an MCP server, with role-specific skills and a configurable LLM provider.
Secured with a bearer token plus a per-turn HMAC ticket scoped to building and role; long-term memory disabled to keep residents' data separate.

name: Webico LMS
tagline: Course-selling learning platform
highlights: Courses and progress tracking, orders and SePay payments, community, notifications and content management.
Signed video streaming with watermarks (Bunny Stream), per-account device limits and access logs.

name: AI Workforce Platform
tagline: AI workforce and plugin platform built on MCP
highlights: Converts MCP servers, OpenAI Actions, n8n, Zapier, LangChain and OpenAPI tools into one standard plugin manifest.
Agents pick plugins by semantic vector search, reranking and an LLM fallback.
Plugins run in Docker and isolated-VM sandboxes with timeouts and resource limits; services talk over gRPC.
Owned the published SDK and its CLI for login, create, deploy and MCP → plugin conversion.

name: Python LLM Services
tagline: Python LLM services: RAG, multi-agent and MCP
highlights: Python RAG chatbots with Qdrant + LangChain + Groq, PydanticAI, and Firecrawl crawling into a vector store.
MCP server that stores agent memory in Neo4j; LangGraph multi-agent patterns for support and article review.
LLM evaluation with promptfoo and observability with Langfuse and OpenTelemetry.

name: Private RAG Agent & Payroll Backend
tagline: Local RAG agent over property data and a Singapore payroll backend
highlights: Private GPT agent: local RAG with FastAPI, FAISS, MiniLM embeddings, Ollama (Gemma 3) and SQLite history.
Payroll backend: e-payslips for Singapore, including IRAS IR8A forms, on AWS Lambda, SQS and S3.

name: Land & GIS Platform
tagline: Thongtin.land, SmartGIS and Onland — large-scale map apps
highlights: Mobile GIS apps for land information and urban planning: planning-map layers, parcel lookup and measurement tools.
Onland: land and real-estate auctions with location features and VNPay payments.
GIS data preparation with GeoTIFF rasters, MBTiles and province shapefiles in QGIS.

name: SLM-Bench
tagline: Benchmark of small language models on accuracy, compute, energy and CO₂ — EMNLP 2025, first author
highlights: Covers 14 domains and 4 hardware configurations.
Reproducible pipeline on Docker and Hugging Face, with a public leaderboard website.

name: LLM Labelling & Crawling Pipelines
tagline: Datasets behind the privacy and GDPR papers
highlights: Async Python pipelines that use GPT-4o to filter and label social-media data.
Play Store crawlers for app metadata, Data Safety sections and privacy policies.
